name: Alfred
summary: SaaS theme for Astro and Tailwind CSS with landing, pricing, integrations, customers, help center and changelog pages.
description: A refined SaaS theme for startups and product teams, built with Astro 7 and Tailwind CSS v4 (OKLCH color system). Ships static pages (home, about, pricing, error 404), content collections (blog, team, changelog, customers, help center) and legal pages, plus a pricing toggle, plan comparison table, integrations directory grouped by category, help center FAQ, custom icon set, logo marquee and Lenis smooth scroll. $89 one-time with lifetime updates; includes Sanity and EmDash CMS variants, SEO, RSS, sitemap and GitHub access with AGENTS.md, SKILLS.md and Cursor rules.
